props.gloss_en: the mishna: these are those whose hide is like their flesh ... [among them] the hide of the hump of a tender camel
how long is a camel tender? R' Yehoshua ben Levi: as long as it has not carried a load
Reish Lakish to R' Yishmael bar Abba: sit opposite me
[Ravin bar Chinnana] kept repeating it; R' Zeira said to him: one [teaching] you had -- you have said it
come and see what is between the harsh ones of the Land of Israel and the pious ones of Babylonia

questions.gloss_en: R' Yirmeya asks: [a camel] whose time to carry a load arrived and it did not carry -- what [of its hump's hide]? Let it stand
Abaye asks: [a camel] whose time to carry had not arrived and it carried -- what? Let it stand
